# CAP002: cap-declared-unused

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | CAP |
| product | grimble |
| severity (default) | warn |

| fix | manual |
| polarity | P- |
| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A node grants a capability atom that no code it owns uses.

Fires per `may` clause when every file the node owns is fully seen, every language present has a detector for the atom and no use is observed in the grant's scope (binding.md 7.2 item 6). Silent, never clean, when a language has no detector, the code is owned only at May or a file hides units: absence is then not Exact.

## Examples

### CAP002 cap-declared-unused / A granted atom never used fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted { owns "src/**"; may exec; may fs.write; }
node d : trusted { owns "design/**"; }
=== src/x.py
import subprocess

def go():
    subprocess.run(["ls"])
```

### CAP002 cap-declared-unused / Every grant used is clean #2 (line 20) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted { owns "src/**"; may exec; }
node d : trusted { owns "design/**"; }
=== src/x.py
```
